title: Generic formal fibres of regular power-series models
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative domain that is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Suppose that $A$ is isomorphic to $k[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ for a field $k$ or to $\Lambda[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ for a Cohen ring $\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring], for some finite $d\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. For every prime ideal $P\subset A$, let $C$ be the maximal-ideal-adic completion of $A_P$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and let $K=\kappa_A(0)$, the fraction field of $A$. Then $K\otimes_A C$ is geometrically regular over $K$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].
